digest.component_or_area: completion verifier and ticket snapshot pinning
propositions: Completion verifier reads a stale local mirror of the ticket store (refs/heads/tickets) instead of the live tracker HEAD, causing it to see outdated ticket state (status, comments, events) not visible in the live store

close_precheck calls materialize_tickets with fetch=False, which pins the main repo's stale local ticket branch rather than the current live tracker HEAD, creating a divergence between the context fed to the model and the snapshot it reads via show_ticket

reconcile_verdict synthesizes a placeholder criterion (unspecified) when a FAIL verdict contains no findings, making it indistinguishable from a parse failure and leaving operators with no remediation path
The pinned snapshot and live store context diverge because fenced context comes from the live store while show_ticket reads the pinned snapshot, allowing the model to observe contradictory evidence

Two separate incidents (wailsome-unsure-asianlion, fixable-angular-caribou) were blocked by reading stale snapshots 6000+ commits behind the live store, presenting as false negatives or spurious budget exhaustion
